brand.title: Build Brand Memory
brand.why: Everything Contivo writes is grounded in this. Without it there is no voice to write in.

market.title: Map the market
market.why: Accept the competitors that are really yours, then generate the positioning charts. Ideas are built from the gaps this reveals.
market.actionDiscover: Discover and accept at least 2 competitors
market.detailPartial: {accepted, number} of {total, number} competitors accepted · no charts yet

keywords.title: Analyse competitor keywords
keywords.why: Shows which topics competitors own and which they leave open. This is where content gets its angle.

narrative.title: Decide what you stand for
narrative.why: Three or four arguments every post has to advance, so the content adds up instead of being forty unrelated posts. Drafted from the intelligence above.

channel.title: Connect somewhere to publish
channel.why: A social account or your own website. Without one, drafts have nowhere to go.
channel.action: Connect an account or add a site

autopilot.title: Turn on Autopilot
autopilot.why: Contivo then ideates, drafts, quality-checks and publishes on your schedule without being asked.

journeyGuide.complete: Setup complete — brand, market, keywords, channel and Autopilot are all in place.
journeyGuide.doneRunning: Autopilot is on. {scheduled, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} queued, {published, number} published so far. Nothing needs you right now — check the Autopilot run history if you want to see what it decided.
journeyGuide.doneIdle: Everything is connected and analysed. Ideate by hand, or turn on Autopilot to let it run without you.
journeyGuide.gateBlocked: This step is not ready yet — {reason}.
journeyGuide.gateConsequence: Running it now will produce nothing useful.
